test_title: PYST 57: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people (A, B, C, D, P, Q, R and S) are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

B is an immediate neighbour of both S and P.

C sits second to the right of P.

R is an immediate neighbour of both D and Q.

A sits second to the left of Q.

What is the position of Q with respect to C?
solution:
**Given: **Eight people (A, B, C, D, P, Q, R and S) are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) B is an immediate neighbour of both S and P 

2) C sits second to the right of P.

3) R is an immediate neighbour of both D and Q (R is between D and Q).

4) A sits second to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/222e178a2aaeed1a3a45ba9dc738e939b06fd63237add7344808aece5476d08c.png] 

 

Therefore, the position of Q with respect to C is **Immediate right**.
